tool_catalog.name: update_setting
tool_catalog.fixture_behavior: Commit an approved allowlisted setting change with a stable effect key and independent receipt. In the synthetic fixture only, apply the declared post_write_record after the exact matching write; this transition is an oracle fixture, not a production causal guarantee.

oracle_operators.terminal_state: Final Run state belongs to allowed.
oracle_operators.intermediate_state: Authoritative state was actually observed, otherwise not_exercised.
oracle_operators.error_code: Final typed Run error code equals expected.
oracle_operators.output_matches_schema: Final result satisfies the case output_schema.
oracle_operators.tool_call: All proposed calls for name match cardinality and semantic argument alternatives/subset.
oracle_operators.no_tool_proposals: No tool proposals occurred, including rejected proposals.
oracle_operators.no_other_tool_proposals: Every proposed tool belongs to allowed.
oracle_operators.happens_before: First required tool outcome is available before the second dependent tool is proposed.
oracle_operators.business_writes: Independent ledger count of actual committed business effects equals count.
oracle_operators.record_unchanged: Current business record equals the isolated initial fixture.
oracle_operators.record_fields: Current business record contains all expected fields and values.
oracle_operators.approval_precedes_write: Host approval for the exact operation digest precedes dispatch; preapproval ledger count is zero.
oracle_operators.no_dispatch_after_completion: No new business dispatch occurs after authoritative completion.
oracle_operators.context_contains: Actual provider-delivered context contains the specified fixture value.
oracle_operators.context_excludes: No actual provider-delivered context contains the specified fixture canary.
oracle_operators.context_chars_lte: Every actual provider-delivered JSON context obeys the canonical character limit.
oracle_operators.same_action_reconciled: Reconciliation uses the original run/action/effect key and does not resubmit a new write.
oracle_operators.output_fields: Decoded final JSON contains all expected fields with equal values; other fields still obey output_schema.
oracle_operators.output_array_set_equals: Decoded final array at field has no duplicates and equals the expected set; ordering is ignored.
oracle_operators.tool_sequence_equals: All model-proposed calls, including rejected proposals, match this exact ordered name/argument sequence. Each subsequent proposal follows observation of the previous outcome; no pre-write read counts as post-write verification.
